cohort: Neonates with persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn (PPHN) who did not respond to inhaled nitric oxide (iNO) alone and subsequently received inhaled iloprost.
finding: Inhaled iloprost was well tolerated and associated with significant improvements in oxygenation indices (increased PaO2 and decreased oxygenation index) within 24 hours of initiating treatment in neonates with PPHN who were responders.
